apps.subtitle: Apollo-Reborn build with Liquid Glass patch
apps.localizedDescription:
### Performance

- Send fewer Reddit requests on **API-Key-Free** accounts by not repeating link preview lookups for sites that block previews and by briefly reusing the Inbox's reply lookups, so ordinary reading reaches Reddit's rate limit later (#1579: @icpryde)
  - New replies, and anything you post or edit, still refresh right away

### Fixes

- Fix **multi-photo posts** showing a reddit.com link and 0 photos since Reddit began marking their photos as failed, so the gallery, feed carousel, media viewer, Save All and Gallery View show them again (#1589: @icpryde)
  - Covers galleries posted from Apollo with Reddit as the Media Upload Host and from other apps; they show as square cards in the feed
- Fix **API-Key-Free search** showing "Error searching" or "Error loading subreddits" for post search, searching within a subreddit or multireddit, and subreddit search (#1557: @DeltAndy123)

apps.name: iTorrent
apps.subtitle: Ordinary iOS torrent client app.
apps.localizedDescription:
## What's new:
* Meet the new built-in VLC player. Play compatible video and audio files directly in iTorrent, even while they are still downloading.
* Enjoy Picture in Picture, playback speeds from 0.5x to 2x, audio and subtitle track selection, precise seeking, and system media controls.
* Take playback to a bigger screen with AirPlay or a compatible player discovered on your local network.
* Choose how pieces are downloaded with Sequential and First & Last priority modes, making it easier to start watching sooner.
* Select and share multiple completed files or entire folders in one go.

## Improvements:
* Refreshed the interface for iOS 26, with Liquid Glass styling, cleaner dialogs, and more polished navigation.
* Made torrent details smoother and easier to use, with clearer download-priority controls and private-torrent information.
* Improved media previewing so iTorrent can offer the best available player for each file.
* Updated the torrent and media engines for better compatibility, stability, and recovery from unexpected errors.
* Expanded and refined translations across all supported languages.

## Fixes:
* Fixed cases where magnet links could be saved incorrectly.
* Fixed a startup race condition that could interfere with launching the app or completing initial setup.
* Fixed toolbars and navigation behaving incorrectly in iPad split-screen mode.
* Fixed RSS downloads returning to the wrong screen.
* Fixed torrent details sometimes getting stuck in a continuous update loop.
* Fixed several playback, AirPlay, and local-device connection issues.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XITRIX/iTorrent/compare/v2.1.1-1...v2.2.0-1

# 2021.9

This is a fork of Olivier Goguel's ActiveGS emulator for iOS.

I've been tinkering it over the years and added some experimental features such as:

- Support for iOS 15
- Remap keyboard to supported wireless controller buttons (mFi/PS4/PS5/XBox One)
- Custom split keyboard usable in landscape mode (written in Swift)

![Simulator Screen Shot - iPhone 13 Pro Max - 2021-09-22 at 22 43 15](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/564774/134484167-3c17c2a7-1d6a-467c-ac82-d7bfae7f281b.png)

- A memory debugger/rudimentary memory-editing cheat engine (also written in Swift). Accessible via the "D" button in the right pane custom keyboard. Browse the memory map and change memory values. Not sure how the bank switching works and how it's mapped to memory but you get some representation of memory. 
![Simulator Screen Shot - iPhone 13 Pro Max - 2021-09-22 at 23 25 55](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/564774/134484125-b984318a-b089-4484-b306-b976521963c3.png)

apps.name: Firebird Emu
apps.subtitle: ARM-based TI-Nspire calculator.
apps.localizedDescription:
# New year, new version: Firebird 1.6

**New features:**
* New dialog for creating Flash images, which is also available in the Mobile UI! (#262) 
* Running as 64bit application on Windows is supported now (#234)
* Polish translation is available now (#207)
* CX II (/-T/CAS) calculators can now be emulated (#165)! However, with the current dumping programs you will not get a complete bootrom and booting the OS will fail.

**Improvements:**
* Multiple files can be sent in the Mobile UI and by dropping them into the main window on desktop (#279)
 Reimplemented emulation speed control: Now it's more accurate, especially on Windows
* GitHub actions now performs automated builds for Android (armeabi-v7a and arm64-v8a in one APK), macOS and Windows (32bit and 64bit) on releases and pull requests (#283, #284, #285)
* The "installer" for OS 4.5.3.14 (and later?) works now. It requires [fastboot RAM](https://hackspire.org/index.php?title=Memory-mapped_I/O_ports_on_CX#90030000_-_Fastboot_RAM) to persist state across reboots, which is now implemented.
* More accurate emulation of the On button: It's now possible to enter Press-To-Test mode (#271)
* Faster saving and loading of snapshots (#231)
* More reliable USB file transfers
* The debugger console now includes entered commands in the log
* Support for PIE (position-independent executables) on x86_64. Previously, care needed to be taken that PIE was disabled, otherwise it would crash on start. (#211)
* Building the JIT is disabled automatically if the platform does not support it (#197)
* Firebird builds on FreeBSD now (#228, #248)

**Bugfixes:**
* File access on Android got fixed (#202 and its various duplicates)
* Fix placement of keypad buttons in the touchpad area (#41)
* Various fixes for the Mobile UI layout (#201)
* The kit configuration page in the Mobile UI no longer causes the keyboard to pop up by default (#257)
* Connecting with GDB on windows works now (#259, #260)
* Some shades of grey were not displayed properly when emulating pre-CX models (#270)
* Fix crash on AArch64/arm64 when executing certain instructions
* The keypad reacts to touch events in the desktop version as well now (#292, #293)
* Some places were no longer translated correctly after the introduction of language switching in 1.5
* Keys could get stuck on focus changes. Now they're all released when the keypad loses focus (#287)
* The Ctrl key now changes color when pressed
* Emulation speed no longer remains unlimited after a failed file transfer

_Repo for Arch, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu and openSUSE: [via OBS](https://software.opensuse.org/download.html?project=home%3AVogtinator%3Afirebird-emu&package=firebird-emu&locale=en)._

There is work in progress to implement and improve support for running in the browser on Qt for WebAssembly (#294). A preview is available on https://nspire-emus.github.io/firebird/wasm/

NOTE: BundleIdentifier changed in this version and automatic updates have been disabled until manual install occurs.

* Running as 64bit application on Windows is supported now (#234)
* Polish translation is available now (#207)
* CX II (/-T/CAS) calculators can now be emulated (#165)! However, with the current dumping programs you will not get a complete bootrom and booting the OS will fail.

**Improvements:**
* Multiple files can be sent in the Mobile UI and by dropping them into the main window on desktop (#279)
 Reimplemented emulation speed control: Now it's more accurate, especially on Windows
* GitHub actions now performs automated builds for Android (armeabi-v7a and arm64-v8a in one APK), macOS and Windows (32bit and 64bit) on releases and pull requests (#283, #284, #285)
* The "installer" for OS 4.5.3.14 (and later?) works now. It requires [fastboot RAM](https://hackspire.org/index.php?title=Memory-mapped_I/O_ports_on_CX#90030000_-_Fastboot_RAM) to persist state across reboots, which is now implemented.
* More accurate emulation of the On button: It's now possible to enter Press-To-Test mode (#271)
* Faster saving and loading of snapshots (#231)
* More reliable USB file transfers
* The debugger console now includes entered commands in the log
* Support for PIE (position-independent executables) on x86_64. Previously, care needed to be taken that PIE was disabled, otherwise it would crash on start. (#211)
* Building the JIT is disabled automatically if the platform does not support it (#197)
* Firebird builds on FreeBSD now (#228, #248)

**Bugfixes:**
* File access on Android got fixed (#202 and its various duplicates)
* Fix placement of keypad buttons in the touchpad area (#41)
* Various fixes for the Mobile UI layout (#201)
* The kit configuration page in the Mobile UI no longer causes the keyboard to pop up by default (#257)
* Connecting with GDB on windows works now (#259, #260)
* Some shades of grey were not displayed properly when emulating pre-CX models (#270)
* Fix crash on AArch64/arm64 when executing certain instructions
* The keypad reacts to touch events in the desktop version as well now (#292, #293)
* Some places were no longer translated correctly after the introduction of language switching in 1.5
* Keys could get stuck on focus changes. Now they're all released when the keypad loses focus (#287)
* The Ctrl key now changes color when pressed
* Emulation speed no longer remains unlimited after a failed file transfer

_Repo for Arch, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu and openSUSE: [via OBS](https://software.opensuse.org/download.html?project=home%3AVogtinator%3Afirebird-emu&package=firebird-emu&locale=en)._

There is work in progress to implement and improve support for running in the browser on Qt for WebAssembly (#294). A preview is available on https://nspire-emus.github.io/firebird/wasm/

* Does not crash on exit due to use of incompatible compile flags with GCC
* Android devices with a lower w/h ratio are marked as supported now
* firebird-send supports different implementations of netcat now
* GDB and remote debugger work after emulation autostart as well
* Moving the cursor over keypad buttons no longer clicks
* On Windows, the filename for snapshots can now include non-ASCII characters
* Fix crash on emulation start on certain x86-64 systems
* Fix freeze on exit on JIT builds for the iOS version

Note: Firebird Emu requires Qt 5.9 now.

# ⚠️This build is OUTDATED. Please use [nightly version](https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/releases/tag/nightly) instead.

# LiveContainer 3.8.0

> [!Warning]
> The standalone version requires **SideStore 0.6.2+** or **AltStore 2.2.1+** for installation.
> To install LiveContainer with built-in SideStore (`LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa`), please use [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details.

# New Features

## Storage Management

- Added a new storage management view with a breakdown of app bundles, containers, temporary files, app group data, tweaks, and other files. (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked)
- Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date.
- Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches.

## Multiple LiveContainers
- Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (#1367)

## Share to Apps in LiveContainer
Added a share extension to LiveContainer. When you share a URL or a file from iOS's share sheet, LiveContainer will ask which app you would like to open the URL/file in, so the old share to LiveContainer shortcut method is no longer needed. When an ipa file is shared in this way, LiveContainer will ask if you want to install it in LiveContainer or in the built-in SideStore (if installed) (#1357)

## Multitasking

- Added per-app multitask preferences. Each app can now follow the global setting, always launch in multitask mode, or avoid multitask mode. (#1208)
- Improved multitask dock behavior: the dock can be made smaller, hidden more cleanly, and has improved padding. (#1228, #1250)
- Added more multitask window animations and improved native-window scene handling.
- URL schemes and `open-url` payloads can be passed to already-running multitask apps and native windows.

## JIT
- Added StosDebug support as a JIT enabler.

## TweakLoader
You can now disable tweaks in the "Tweaks" page in LiveContainer's UI. by @SAOMDVN

# Improvements
- Added support for manually setting a container's IDFV. (#1194)
- IDFV spoofing works even when Tweakloader is not loaded.
- Reworked signing logic for tweaks and app installation, with multithreaded signing support.
- Download alerts now block tab switching while a download is in progress.
- Crash reports are shown in a sheet instead of a large alert for better performance on newer iOS versions.
- Add a "Clear Notification" button (#1388)
- Added some popular NSBonjourServices keys so apps can discover AirPlay devices and remote pairing pairable hosts in the local network. (#1417)

# Bug Fixes

- Fixed `livecontainer://open-url` dropping the deep link when launching an app from a cold start. (#1339)
- Fixed the Add to Home Screen menu failing or behaving incorrectly by replacing the SwiftUI context menu implementation. (#1209)
- Fixed a crash when opening Container Preferences if the app did not contain an `en.lproj` path. (#1239)
- Fixed apps and AltStore sources not being searchable in some cases. (#1365, #1368)
- Fixed converting a shared app back to private after aborting an install with the same bundle identifier, which could leave stale container state behind. (#1347)
- Fixed shortcuts and JIT flows getting stuck on a busy LiveContainer instance instead of using another available instance. (#1386)
- Fixed file picker not workings for some apps because Tweakloader is not loaded after enabling "Hide LiveContainer from dyld API". (#1430)
- Fixed several app launch compatibility issues on iOS 26.5 beta, and some multitask/JIT app launches. (#1300, #1310, #1329)
- Fixed multitask keyboard focus issues on iOS 17.4+, including cases where the keyboard would not appear, Passwords would immediately close, or video playback would freeze in multitask mode. (#1402, #844, #870)
- Added support for iOS 27 developer beta. (#1394, #1417, #1416)
- Fix background downloads in multitask apps (choosing "Keep App Extensions (Register App ID for Each Extension)" is required). (#1415)

# Localization

- Updated translations. Added Spanish translation by @Deci8BelioS

# Credits

Thanks to everyone who contributed code, fixes, testing, and reports for this release, including @boa-z, @ruri1208, @Project516, @yazdipour, @stossy11, and @SAOMDVN.

Great thanks to everyone who helped translate LiveContainer.

apps.name: UTM
apps.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS (with JIT support)
apps.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.

## Changes (v5.0.8)
* Fixed several changes listed for v5.0.7 being left out of that build by mistake.
* (macOS) Fixed Windows 3D acceleration on Apple Silicon Macs without Rosetta by falling back to DXMT
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows installs from the USB CD drive stalling repeatedly, which made them much slower in v5.0.7 (#7970)

## Changes (v5.0.7)
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration
* ~~QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)~~ This was dropped and will be included in the next update.
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson)
* (macOS 15) QEMU: Better performance on Apple Silicon with the Hypervisor.framework built-in interrupt controller
* (macOS) Scripting: Force stopping a paused VM is now allowed
* (macOS 27) AVF: Explain when a USB device such as a webcam or phone can't be passed through, instead of showing "VZErrorDomain error -6" (#7914)
* (macOS) Guest Agent: Fixed an issue where clipboard sharing fails upon suspend-resume in macOS guests (you need to re-install the latest guest tools) (#7717)

## Changes (v5.0.6)
* Raised the minimum supported versions to macOS 12 and iOS 15 (#7758)
* Updated the DXMT and MoltenVK graphics backends
* Updated the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver, which now requires macOS 26 or iOS 26
* Home: The welcome screen now offers to open an existing VM instead of linking to the gallery
* Snapshots: New Snapshots tab to save, overwrite, restore, rename and delete snapshots of QEMU and Apple VMs. Requires iOS 26 on iOS and macOS 27 for Apple VMs (#5484)
* Settings: Custom QEMU arguments moved to their own page, and the full command line is shown as read-only text that can be copied (#489, #7604)
* SPICE: Fixed microphone audio quality (#7751)
* SPICE: Fixed display and input freezing when audio playback hangs under memory pressure (thanks @evan314159)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed typing into the built-in serial terminal (#7814)
* Terminal: Updated SwiftTerm with a new Metal renderer, and only web links printed by the guest can be opened
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS) Fixed the VM toolbar and external display on iOS 26 and iOS 27
* (iOS 26) Reclaim Space, Compress, Resize and converting imported drives to qcow2 are now available on iOS (#4774)
* (iOS 27) Confirm before closing the window of a running VM on iPad
* (iOS) Display: Long press and pan gestures respond immediately, touches at the screen edges reach the guest, new middle click and right/middle drag actions, and a new "Touch mode (drag to scroll)" (#4738)
* (iOS) Display: Redesigned the keyboard accessory bar to match the iOS 26 keyboard
* (iOS) Input: Game controller Options and Home buttons can now be mapped
* (iOS) Settings: Fixed selecting the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver
* (macOS) VoiceOver now announces file browse fields by their name (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Terminal: Added a find bar (Cmd-F)
* (macOS 27) Display: New option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen (#6183)
* (macOS 27) Display: Hot Corners are turned off while a VM is in full screen
* (macOS) Settings: Improved the notes field
* (macOS 26) Settings: The "New…" device menu now matches the sidebar

## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.

## Changes (v5.0.8)

## Highlights
* **Rewrite of QEMU support internals.** Much of the code to support QEMU has been refactored into a new project, [QEMUKit](https://github.com/utmapp/QEMUKit), which will make it easier to support QEMU changes as well as support for new platforms.
* **TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot** This is required for Windows 11 updates to 22H2. To enable TPM on an existing virtual machine (only x86_64, i386, and ARM64 architectures are supported), open the VM settings, go to the QEMU page and select "UEFI Boot", "TPM 2.0 Device", and "Reset UEFI Variables." Any new VM created through the wizard will have TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot enabled by default if Windows 10+ support is checked.
* **Download Windows installer with a new utility.** We know that creating a Windows installer can be a hassle which is why we are releasing a new free tool called CrystalFetch which can be found on [GitHub](https://github.com/TuringSoftware/CrystalFetch) as well as free on the [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/crystalfetch-iso-downloader/id6454431289). This companion to UTM will allow you to generate a Windows 11 ISO with a few clicks (no Terminal, Homebrew, or scripts required). Note that just like before, you still need a valid license from Microsoft to use Windows.

## Notes
* On i386 and x86_64 machines, HPET is now disabled by default. This improves performance (slightly) on some guests and also addresses boot issues with OpenIndiana. This change means that suspended VM state from previous versions are not compatible, so please shut down those VMs before updating. If you require HPET to be enabled for any reason, go into the VM's settings and under QEMU → QEMU Machine Properties, add the text `hpet=on`.
* In v4.3.5, we rolled back backend updates to QEMU and EDK2 due to a critical issue that prevented VMs from booting. While the issue is investigated, the last stable version will be used and once the issue is resolved, a new update will be released.

## Changes (v4.3.5)
* Rollback QEMU version to 7.2.0
* Rollback EDK2 firmware to edk2-stable202102
* Reduced amount of logging when Debug Log is not checked
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed boot ISO not saving for AVF (#5517)

## Changes (v4.3.4)
* Localization: Updated Japanese (thanks @MMP0)
* Fixed WebDAV shared directory not setup on start (#5506)
* (macOS) Improved debug logging by showing more verbose logging for SPICE. If "Enable Debug Log" is selected, more verbose logging will be activated.
* (macOS) Fixed an issue where the VM freezes or shows "port not connected" when the computer is under memory pressure (#5489)
* (macOS 11) Disabled options in the context menu which had broken UI leading to freezes or crashes (#5147)
* (macOS 12) Wizard: Fixed a crash when selecting a file with VoiceOver (#5250)
* (macOS 12+) Settings: new table view for QEMU custom arguments

## Changes (v4.3.3)
* Fixed a crash when selecting a VM (#5481)
* Fixed a crash when starting a VM and an error occurred when creating display/serial devices (#5472)
* Fixed boot issues when trying to load OpenIndiana by disabling HPET timers by default (#2394)
* Fixed an issue where selected removable drive image and shared directory are not syncing correctly
* QEMUKit: Fixed race condition when multiple RPC commands are sent (#5477)
* EDK2: Fixed an issue preventing some versions of Windows 11 from booting (#5495)
* utmctl: Add a more verbose error message when utmctl fails because it is launched from an SSH session or before logging in (#5499)
* Wizard: Fixed selected boot ISO not saving (#5471)
* Wizard: Link to CrystalFetch when Windows is selected
* (macOS) AVF: Automatically un-capture system keys when VM terminates

## Changes (v4.3.2)
* The last update introduced two units per bus for IDE devices. However, some machines do not support this configuration, so now two units per bus will only be enabled for supported machines. Other machines will retain pre v4.3.1 behaviour.
* Fixed some state tracking issues leading to various errors when a VM is quickly stopped and started again.
* Changed the style of the icons on various VM operations in the home screen and context menu (iOS) (thanks @jnsdrtlf) (#5441, #4759)
* Fixed an issue where serial device hardware was not saved
* Fixed the error that shows up when trying to rename a VM (#5444)
* Fixed a crash on startup due to mishandling of VM parsing (#5424)
* Fixed debug logging not working due to backend changes in v4.3.1
* Fixed a crash when QEMU tries to output non-printable characters
* Add support for SWTPM for TPM 2.0 emulation
* Add Secure Boot firmware for ARM64. Only the Secure Boot firmwares have TPM 2.0 support built in, so when TPM 2.0 and UEFI are enabled, UTM will automatically select the Secure Boot firmware. By default the UTM platform keys and Microsoft key exchange keys are enrolled. You can manually set up your own keys from the UEFI menu.
* Updated the EDK2 UEFI firmware to the 202305 release
* Debug logs will no longer be deleted when a VM configuration is saved and debug log is not disabled
* Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor stopped working due to backend changes in v4.3.1
* If the Documents directory does not exist in UTM's container, it will now be created automatically. This addresses an error that shows up if the Documents directory does not get created properly by macOS. (#5419)
* Localization: Updated Japanese (thanks @MMP0)
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where TSO setting was not saved
* (macOS) Fixed an issue where every time a VM is started with a terminal window, the width of the window gets a bit larger
* (macOS) Fixed an issue where starting a stopped VM does not change the display scale
* (macOS) AVM: System keys will be captured automatically when entering full screen and released when exiting full screen (#3668)
* (macOS) AVM: Fixed the request stop method in both the GUI and scripting interfaces (#5425)

## Changes (v4.3.1)
* Updated QEMU backend to v8.0.2
* Refactored QEMU support to a new project: [QEMUKit](https://github.com/utmapp/QEMUKit)
* Machines with IDE interface (i44FX/PIIX) will now support two units per bus. Previously, we mapped IDE devices to one unit per bus. This means on some machines, the limit was two devices maximum. Now, we map two units per IDE bus which should increase the limit to four devices. Existing VMs will _not_ get this change automatically in order to maintain compatibility. You can choose to opt-in to this new mapping by pressing the “Update Interface” button on each IDE drive in the VM settings. (#5358)
* Localization: Updated Japanese (thanks @MMP0 and @studio1a9)
* (macOS) Fixed crash when AVM window is closed (#5347)
* (macOS) New option “Automatic” for bridged network connection which will use the bridge the first active connection on the host. Both AVM and QEMU backends are supported. (#5410)
* (macOS) Fixed trackpad setting not saving (#5369)

## Changes (v4.3.0)
* Updated QEMU backend to v8.0.0
* Changed audio backend from CoreAudio back to SPICE (as it was before v4.2.x). Clarify that CoreAudio backend does not support microphone (#5253)
* Add support for mouse buttons 4 and 5 (#5295)
* Wizard: Properly display an error message when there is a failure writing to disk (#5271)
* Fixed an issue where ISAPC emulation target cannot be started (#5280)
* Fixed CoreAudio being instantiated even when audio is disabled
* Fixed an issue where legacy VMs with AC97 sound card has an empty name in settings
* Fixed an QEMU issue where the `ucomiss` instruction causes a crash in some applications (#5294)
* Fixed an issue preventing VMs with commas in their name from starting (note only new VMs will be fixed) (#5332)
* (macOS) AVM: Support canceling macOS installation
* (macOS) utmctl: Added `delete` command (#5290)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue creating a shortcut from drag & drop as well as double clicking from Finder (#5310, #5311)
* (macOS) Added DHCP start/end settings for vmnet (#5301)
* (macOS) Added automatically syncing of system clock when macOS wakes up from sleep (when QEMU guest agent is installed) (#5252)

## Issues
Please check the full list on [Github](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/issues) and help report any bug you find that is not listed.

## Installation

* [iOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/)
* [macOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/)

| File | Description | Installation | JIT | Hypervisor | USB |
|------|------------|--------------|-----|-----------|-----|
| UTM.deb | Jailbroken iOS version | Open in Cydia, dpkg, or Sileo | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM.dmg | macOS version | Mounting and copying UTM.app to /Applications | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| UTM.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, etc (see guide) | Yes(2) | No | No |
| UTM.HV.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (TrollStore) | TrollStore | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM.SE.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, enterprise signing, etc | No | No | No |

1. Hypervisor on iOS requires an M1 iPad.
2. Enabling JIT may require a separate JIT enabler such as [Jitterbug][2] or Jitstreamer.

[1]: https://getutm.app/install/
[2]: https://github.com/osy/Jitterbug

## Highlights
* **QEMU backend updated to v8.0.2**
* **Rewrite of QEMU support internals.** Much of the code to support QEMU has been refactored into a new project, [QEMUKit](https://github.com/utmapp/QEMUKit), which will make it easier to support QEMU changes as well as support for new platforms. This means that v4.3.1 may contain a lot of UI bugs as testing is needed to make sure the new internals match up with the existing UI. Please help us by reporting any such issue you stumble upon.
* **TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot** This is required for Windows 11 updates to 22H2. To enable TPM on an existing virtual machine (only x86_64, i386, and ARM64 architectures are supported), open the VM settings, go to the QEMU page and select "UEFI Boot", "TPM 2.0 Device", and "Reset UEFI Variables." Any new VM created through the wizard will have TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot enabled by default if Windows 10+ support is checked.
* **Download Windows installer with a new utility.** We know that creating a Windows installer can be a hassle which is why we are releasing a new free tool called CrystalFetch which can be found on [GitHub](https://github.com/TuringSoftware/CrystalFetch) as well as free on the [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/crystalfetch-iso-downloader/id6454431289). This companion to UTM will allow you to generate a Windows 11 ISO with a few clicks (no Terminal, Homebrew, or scripts required). Note that just like before, you still need a valid license from Microsoft to use Windows.

## Notes
On i386 and x86_64 machines, HPET is now disabled by default. This improves performance (slightly) on some guests and also addresses boot issues with OpenIndiana. This change means that suspended VM state from previous versions are not compatible, so please shut down those VMs before updating. If you require HPET to be enabled for any reason, go into the VM's settings and under QEMU → QEMU Machine Properties, add the text `hpet=on`.

* (macOS 11) Disabled options in the context menu which had broken UI leading to freezes or crashes (#5147)

## Changes (v4.3.3)

apps.name: AirCard-iOS
apps.subtitle: Apple Wallet card skins, passcode themes and wallpapers
apps.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed in v1.3.2 🚀

This update brings full feature parity with AirCard macOS v1.2.6, restores robust card discovery across all iOS versions, introduces automatic bank/network recognition with custom card nicknames, delivers an ultra-fast tunnel cache (0.02s connections), and completely resolves wallpaper flashing for Collections and Mercury wallpapers.

### 💳 Wallet Card Discovery & Bank Identification
• **Universal Wallet Log Parser**: Ported the proven `WalletScanParser` from AirCard macOS. Captures cards from `Dashboard loading (...): for SOO+`, `passIDs[InSession]`, `passIDs[global]`, and modern JSON NFC activations (`"identifier": "HEX"`).
• **Automatic Bank & Network Detection**: Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Discover, and JCB via applet AIDs during selection.
• **Card Nicknames (Rename)**: Added a direct **Rename** button (✏️) so you can give your cards friendly names like *"Monobank"*, *"Salary Card"*, or *"Revolut"*, safely persisted in app settings.
• **28-Character Fallback Token Matcher**: Restores dependable card discovery on devices where standard log patterns are redacted.

### ⚡ Ultra-Fast Tunnel Routing (from 10s to 0.02s!)
• **Working Route Caching**: `rust-core` now caches the active RSD connection route (`LAST_WORKING_ROUTE`), eliminating repeated port and interface scanning.
• **RSD-First Priority**: Connects directly via RemoteXPC on port 49152, bypassing slow Lockdown retries and broken pipes on iOS 18+.
• **Eliminated Loopback Policy Drops**: Removed local loopback attempts that caused `policy drop` control channel errors.

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies) — Collections & Mercury Fixes
• **Dual Injection on iOS 18+**: Wallpapers are now injected into both their primary bundle (`com.apple.WallpaperKit.CollectionsPoster` or `com.apple.MercuryPoster`) and the modern iOS 18+ application container (`com.apple.Posters.CollectionsPosterApp` / `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp`).
• **Metadata Synchronization**: Fixed a critical issue where `Wallpaper.plist`'s numeric identifier was randomized out-of-sync with `suggestionMetadata.plist` (`7400.DYNAMIC`), causing wallpapers like Windows 11 to vanish from the Lock Screen gallery.
• **Mercury Wallpaper Support**: Added recognition for `mercury-descriptors` container folders and registered `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp` in `PersistedPosterContainerBundleIdentifiers`.
• **NeoSpring Respring**: Instant springboard reload to apply wallpaper preferences immediately.

### 🧪 Quality & Testing
• All 24 unit tests passing (`TendiesEngineTests`, `WalletScanParserTests`, `CardPhotoCropTests`, `CardPhotoPickerTests`).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

apps.name: AniBaka
apps.subtitle: 跨平台番剧聚合、媒体播放与弹幕客户端
apps.localizedDescription:
### 新增

- Windows 新增 AnimeJaNai 实时超分：播放器底栏一键开关，可与 Anime4K、DLSS 叠加；支持 TensorRT / DirectML 后端自动选择，提供质量、均衡、性能三档与原版、Sharp1 两种模型，附细节锐化、亮度、对比度、饱和度、伽马调节及原画/超分同帧对比。
- AnimeJaNai 可选 RIFE 补帧：支持 2×、3×、4× 倍率，提供完整（原分辨率处理）与快速（最高 540p 处理）两种方案。
- 新增“画质设置”面板，整合 AnimeJaNai 与 DLSS 全部选项；播放器内长按增强按钮或进入“实验室”页面均可打开，运行状态、安装进度与诊断信息集中展示。
- Windows 播放器底栏常显 Anime4K / AnimeJaNai / DLSS 开关，点按切换、长按进入画质设置，无需先在实验室开启。
- 评论区改版：正文按 Markdown / BBCode 渲染，评论中的时间点自动识别为跳转链接，点击可seek到对应进度或指定集数；表情贴图正常显示，加载时改用骨架占位。

### 优化

- 更新优化内置源规则
- DLSS 与 AnimeJaNai 运行库改由组织维护的 media-kit fork 统一打包，应用内不再捆绑原生桥接代码，减小安装体积。
- 充分优化日志系统
- 优化了一些小细节

### 使用说明

- AnimeJaNai 仅支持 Windows；首次启用需联网下载运行库与模型（补帧组件约 441 MiB），下载过程可取消，TensorRT 后端首次使用需编译引擎。
- 后端设为“自动”时，支持的 NVIDIA 显卡优先使用 TensorRT，其余显卡使用 DirectML。
- AnimeJaNai 模型按 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 分发，仅限非商业用途。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AniBakaBaka/AniBaka/compare/5.2.3+1020...5.2.4+1101

macOS 自动更新支持增量下载，减少下载流量并加快更新 - 新增 JSON API 数据源 - 修复一系列播放相关问题 ---- - TV 端支持配置全局网络代理 (#3550 by @LoliWolf) - Android 支持通过包含 Bangumi 章节 ID 或剧集 ID 的 ani 链接打开指定剧集 - 优化续播与换源体验，直接从记忆进度开始播放，减少重复缓冲并避免换源后进度回退 - 优化剧集页播放器快捷键，切换标签页或关闭侧边栏后可直接操作视频，输入文字时避免误触快捷键 (#3542 by @Tsukumi233) - 修复桌面端在部分多显卡或渲染模式切换场景下视频黑屏、窗口空白的问题 - 修复 Windows 退出播放页时可能卡死的问题 - 修复 Windows 和 Linux 播放纯音频媒体时可能卡在加载中的问题 - 修复 Android 播放部分 MKV 视频时无法显示压缩字幕的问题，支持 ASS 和 SRT 字幕 - 修复 Android 暂停或播放结束后切换全屏时画面缩在左侧或被裁切的问题 - 修复 Android 应用语言切换不生效的问题 - 修复 Jellyfin 数据源切集后找不到下一集资源的问题 - 修复部分网络环境下数据源因页面链接使用 HTTP 而无法加载的问题 (#3633 by @wdw89) - 修复进入或切换页面时自动聚焦输入框、滑块等控件，导致页面意外滚动的问题 (#3650 by @NihilDigit) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-ani/animeko/compare/v6.3.0...v6.4.0 [//]: # (ANI-SERVER-MAGIC-SEPARATOR) [//]: # (注意: api server apps.name: ARMSX2
apps.subtitle: PlayStation 2 emulator for ARM64
apps.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.

apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

This build brings everything since 0.1.634: external drives, Windows Vulkan for 64-bit games (experimental, per game), Ubisoft Connect with Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4, a native interface for the foldable iPhone (experimental), colour profiles, many Direct3D 9, 11 and 12 fixes, Steam (BCD Dock) fixes, recommended settings for 60 more games and over 150 new Auto-tune rules.

## New

- **New icon:** BCD has a new app icon by Mila (mudcatpot), with versions for iOS's dark and tinted home screens. Thank you, Mila!
- **External drives:** **Settings › Storage › External drives › Add a drive or folder** adds a drive (a USB-C SSD or a stick) or a folder on it; you can add several. Each drive appears in Windows as `C:\External\<name>` and as a drive letter.
  - **Find games** adds the games on a drive to your library, and the drive's Steam libraries are found by themselves: their games start through BCD Dock like any other Steam game.
  - A Steam game's page offers **External drive** for a new install (**Steam installs** in the same settings picks the default place), and Steam updates and repairs a game in the library it lives in.
  - **Location › Move to** on a game's page moves a Steam game, or a game you added from Files, between the device and a drive: it copies the game, checks the copy, then deletes the original. The game keeps its settings, Workshop items and launch options.
  - Before a download, files already on the disk are checked once, so a repaired or moved game is not downloaded again.
  - The earlier External SSD folder becomes a drive by itself, with its games and their settings. If it does not open at the first start, BCD tries again at the next start or at Play.
  - **Reconnect** opens a drive again after it was unplugged; **Remove** forgets it.
- **Windows Vulkan (experimental, 64-bit games):** a game's page has **Direct3D › Vulkan (experimental)**. With it, a 64-bit game that draws with Vulkan gets Vulkan through MoltenVK (`vulkan = moltenvk`). Off by default; turn it on per game.
- **Ubisoft Connect, Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4:**
  - Ubisoft Connect no longer stops right after its start.
  - Its built-in browser runs with fewer processes, so it fits.
  - Its installer is not run again for every Ubisoft game once the launcher is installed.
  - A game started through it gets the settings the launcher needs for that session only.
  - Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4 have recommended settings.
- **Foldable iPhone (experimental):** **Settings › Graphics › Foldable iPhone** has two switches, both off by default and both changing nothing on other iPhones and iPads.
  - **Duo enhancements** gives BCD a native interface with Liquid Glass, system tabs and a sidebar, search in the Library and controller navigation. The Windows desktop's Start, Open and Stop sit on Home, and downloads resume when the desktop runs in the background.
  - **Foldable iPhone support** starts a game you add at a resolution shaped like the inner display, and the touch controls follow the screen when you fold or unfold the phone.
  - Installed directly, iOS shows BCD in a small window on the inner display; inside LiveContainer it fills the screen. Both switches apply from the next start of BCD.
- **Colour profiles:** **Settings › Appearance** picks BCD's colours. The default look is unchanged.
- **Xbox 360 controller identity:** **Controls › Controller API › Xbox 360 controller (XInput + device)** on a game's page keeps the XInput pad and also lists it as an Xbox 360 controller, for a game that shows no controller otherwise (Far Cry 4).
- **Aim with a stick:** an aim zone can drive the right stick instead of the mouse (**Aim mode › The finger moves › The right stick** on a game's page), for a game that ignores the mouse while a controller is in use (NieR).

## Fixes and improvements

> **Tried a game on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

Each fix targets the error a log showed; a game may now get further and still stop at a later point. If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem.

### Games

Every game a log, a report or a test reached since 0.1.634. Where a game is not fixed, its line says which stop it passes now or which stop is named, and where it stops next when a log shows that.

#### Fixed in code

The stop the log showed cannot happen the same way any more. Almost none of these could be tried on a device yet, so a game may now get further and stop at a later point; where a log shows where that is, it is said.

- **1000xRESIST:** the Unity IL2CPP garbage collector raced with the game and ended it after 14 to 15 repairs of the same three virtual calls, about 16 seconds in at 54 FPS (the earlier frame-context experiment did not help). The repair has a fourth pass now that takes the object's class word and proves the table before it writes; and the recommended settings make the collector really suspend the game's threads (as for Megabonk, Big Walk, BALL x PIT and Lonely Mountains). Fixed for that fault; not tested on a device yet.
- **Age of Wonders 4:** the game asked Metal for a multisampled view of a single-sample texture and Metal's validation ended the game. The view now takes the texture's own type. Fixed.
- **Alan Wake:** about 67 Direct3D 9 pipelines per run were refused by the graphics driver, because a vertex shader that writes the point size was used in triangle draws; those draws were missing. The point size is now written only in point draws. Fixed. Text in a sent log's comment also no longer counts as the game's own log lines (it had produced a false "known stop"). For the crash at the end of a run, where BCD itself ended while a game thread exited, two experiments exist for the game's own settings, off by default: `env.MADEIRA_EXIT_POOL_DIAG = 1` names the object and `env.MADEIRA_EXIT_POOL_SKIP = 1` skips that clean-up.
- **Assassin's Creed (2007):** it died after Steam's helper program unloaded and cleared the game's thread-local data. A program's `TlsFree` now clears slots only in its own program's threads, as on Windows (`env.MADEIRA_TLS_CLEAR_OWN_PROCESS = 0` brings the old behaviour back). Fixed.
- **Battlefield 2 and Cold Fear:** the shader converter did not know the compressed-normal vertex formats DEC3N and UDEC3 and stopped the game, Battlefield 2 about 40 seconds in and Cold Fear at its first 3D scene. Both formats are converted now. Fixed. Battlefield 2 with a Direct3D wrapper in its folder can also stop on a stale memory alias; Auto-tune now tries the setting that releases stale memory aliases for it.
- **BioShock:** the game stopped about 110 seconds after the logos, when its renderer thread read a NULL getter right after the first run-time HLSL compiles. Wine's D3DX compile functions never wrote the result variable (`pHResult`) that the game passes; the six functions now write it as Windows documents. This is the likely cause, not proved; if it still stops, the log now holds the compiler's text for every failed compile (24 per process, with the first 160 bytes of the source). The recommended settings keep a file trace of 20,000 lines so the name of the shader-error file shows. For "no sound after the intro", `env.MADEIRA_AUDIO_CAPTURE = 1` (off by default; put it in the game's own settings) offers one silent recording device, never the microphone and never mixed.
- **Black Mesa:** its own crash handler closes the game with exit code 1 after 17 seconds, and the BCD Dock session stayed open on a dead picture. A game that closes within 30 seconds without a picture now ends its session, whatever its exit code. Fixed. The crash itself (a call from Qt's QML engine into an empty page) is not fixed; the log now says whether BCD's views of that page agree.
- **Blur:** the game's protected start-up code uses an x86 bit-scan with a redundant prefix that the emulator rejected ("Invalid instruction"). That form and a few similar ones now decode. Fixed; the stub may stop at its next instruction.
- **Bulletstorm, Hitman: Blood Money, Medal of Honor: Airborne and LEGO Marvel Super Heroes** (BCD Dock): the 32-bit game said Steam was not running (error 113, "Problem starting up Steam") because the Dock wrote Steam's entries only where 64-bit programs read them. They are now also written where a 32-bit game reads them (an entry of a client that is gone is overwritten for the session). Fixed. Bulletstorm's recommended settings also dump the registers at its start-up fault; started directly, Hitman: Blood Money shows "Failed to find Steam", which Auto-tune now answers with "start it with BCD Dock".
- **Capcom games** (Resident Evil 3, Resident Evil 4, Resident Evil Requiem, Monster Hunter Rise, Monster Hunter Stories 3 trial, Mega Man Zero/ZX Legacy Collection, Onimusha): their first start ran only Capcom's codec notice, a .NET program that cannot run under Wine Mono and installs nothing, then asked you to restart BCD. BCD now treats that notice as provided, so the first Play starts the game. Fixed. For Mega Man Zero/ZX Legacy Collection and Monster Hunter Rise, whose packed program then stopped in other logs, Auto-tune also tries switching off the emulator's multi-block translation after its earlier attempt.
- **Counter-Strike 2:** the sound broke up in every pass (fixed, see the sound fix below). The Dock start also ended at Steam's "update required" (error 19) without a word: the starting screen and Auto-tune now say that the game needs an update and to install it from its page. A Dock session that never drew a frame is also no longer counted as played, which lets Auto-tune's start rules fire for it.
- **DmC: Devil May Cry:** two logs met the Mono case described below (the check now runs by default). Its other stop, the engine's own `abort()` after 28 seconds with an empty log mirror, is not fixed: its recommended settings now mirror the engine's launch log so the next log names the error.
- **DOOM 3: BFG Edition:** a library entry whose program is `language_setup.exe` (a Qt language chooser that exits 0) looked like a game that closed by itself. The folder scan no longer offers that program, and a setup or language tool that closes within 15 seconds with exit code 0 and no picture now gets a note: "It looks like a setup or language tool, not the game. Add the game's own program from the same folder." Fixed.
- **Dying Light:** on a prefix whose Valve client files BCD Dock does not know, the start could not work and said little. BCD Dock now stops with a message that names the unsupported file; **Settings › BCD Dock › Valve's client files › Replace client components** puts the supported client in place, keeping the old folder and the installed games (not tested on a device yet). The recommended settings also mirror the engine's own log, because one run ended itself through the Steam client library's crash handler after 24 seconds (cause not known), and an experiment for a borderless window smaller than the screen, `env.MADEIRA_DISPLAY_FOLLOW_BORDERLESS = 1`, is off by default.
- **FIFA 23:** about 22 seconds in, the encode thread of the Direct3D 11 layer died on `UpdateSubresource` of a staging buffer, which Direct3D 11 ignores. Such a call is ignored now, and the recommended settings use the source-built Direct3D 11 that carries the fix. Fixed; later start-up steps of the game are not known.
- **FINAL FANTASY VII (2013):** the Qt 4 launcher died because a 33-character font face name overflowed a 32-character field and the SDK's checked copy aborted the host thread. The name is cut to what fits. Fixed.
- **FTL: Faster Than Light and Peggle Deluxe:** both locked up at their start: the emulator's thread-creation lock was taken twice by the thread that held it, when their sound library changed memory protection. The lock lets its owner in again. Fixed. Peggle Deluxe has a second stop that Auto-tune names (a host store into a page just made read-only); Auto-tune's experiment for it makes the game's executable memory plain read/write.
- **Grand Theft Auto V (Legacy, Enhanced and the Epic copy):**
  - the Epic copy of Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced starts Windows services with a native ARM64 program (`services.exe`) whose first emulator hook crashed on a thread with no emulator area; the hooks now leave such a thread alone, so the launcher can reach its service manager (not tested; a second stop in that program's first exception handling is named, not fixed);
  - the Grand Theft Auto V Legacy launcher's child program crashed in the emulator's allocation watch before its thread storage existed; that function now returns early when nothing is watched;
  - when the emulator's pooled memory ran out (Enhanced, 339 seconds in), it wrote through a NULL buffer on four threads at once; it now takes back idle buffers first, retries, and then refuses the allocation cleanly, so the game gets an error at its own address instead of a wedged emulator;
  - Social Club's browser helper could end BCD in a stale-pointer repair after a library was unmapped; that read is now checked;
  - the Launcher can say Steam is not running (error 113) although it is: this build logs a replica of the Launcher's own check so the next log names the failing step (Auto-tune says so), and a library entry without Steam can turn on the Windows services with `env.MADEIRA_ROCKSTAR_LOCAL_SERVICES = 1` (off by default).
- **Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX:** its launcher creates a Direct3D 12 bundle allocator, BCD answered "not implemented", and the launcher called through the NULL it got. Bundles now work: a bundle's commands are copied into the list that executes it. Fixed.
- **Maneater:** BCD's own fault handler died on a wild return address while it was only writing a log line, which ended the game after about 45 seconds with no message. Those reads are now checked. Fixed; what the game does next is not known.
- **Mass Effect: Legendary Edition and Selaco:** the emulator's own fault at process exit (its memory hooks used a context that was already gone) was filed as the end of the run and hid the real reason (Steam's ticket, no running Steam, a GPU-bound stall). The hooks now stand down once the process is terminating. Fixed.
- **Meccha Chameleon:** the Dock session never ended after the game's abort (exit code 3). That ends the session now. Fixed. Its Unreal loading thread also calls COM without an apartment and crashes; Auto-tune can add a rebuilt `combase` that creates the implicit apartment (not tested).
- **Mono and Unity games** that hung or crashed because a Mono code chunk started in the slack behind a mapped .NET assembly: the check for that case is now on by default (`env.MADEIRA_MZ_VIEW_CHECK = 0` restores the old handling). With the check off, 35 of the 36 archived sessions that met the case hung or crashed; with it on, Cult of the Lamb, Risk of Rain 2, Flotsam, Valheim and Probably Stolen ran. Fixed for Hollow Knight, Hollow Knight: Silksong, ULTRAKILL, Subnautica: Below Zero, FEZ, Owlboy, Graveyard Keeper 2, Thief Simulator 3, Universe Sandbox, SpeedRunners 2, Another Crab's Treasure, CloverPit, Sorry We're Closed, TerraTech and Wizard with a Gun, and possibly for Happy's Humble Burger Farm (it hung when started from the library and played from the Windows desktop). Probably Stolen, on a first Dock start without a network connection, is now told to connect once (no saved sign-in).
- **Need for Speed: Underground:** a page that the emulator promoted, freed and reused with data execution prevention off was never promoted again and ended in "no execute". It is promoted again. Fixed.
- **NTE: Neverness to Everness and Dominus Gladiatus:** the emulator's allocation of a 16 MB (and, for Dominus Gladiatus, 8 MB) code-translation buffer failed, and it wrote at address 0x800010 holding a lock that wedged every other thread. It now takes back idle pooled buffers first, then retries, then refuses the allocation cleanly, so the game gets a fault at its own address. Fixed; if its memory is truly full the session usually still ends, now without a wild write.
- **PRAGMATA:** like the other Capcom games above, its first Play ran only Capcom's codec notice and now starts the game. The program then reads a wild pointer in its first second; its recommended settings add the protected-code experiment (registers that only look like shared-page pointers are left alone), which should pass that first second if the guess is right.
- **Prison Architect and Hearts of Iron IV** (and the other Paradox games started through `dowser.exe`): the launcher stub could not find `msiexec`, and its installer failed on a missing `Msi.dll`. The Dock now gives the launcher Windows Installer. Fixed for those two steps; the launcher may stop at a later wall. Hearts of Iron IV's recommended settings also list the same files.
- **Quake II, Resonance, Counter-Strike 2, Deadlock, Dead Rising, Murder Miners, MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, Mina the Hollower, Story of Seasons, Metal Gear Solid 2, Jazzpunk, Need for Speed: The Run, skate and NW.js games** (about 20 games, 40 logs; Metal Gear Solid 2's launcher also hung on build 634, which is likely the Mono case above): the sound broke up because the game queues two 10 ms periods while iOS pulls about 21 ms, so every pass had a gap. When a stream comes up short in nearly every pass for 20 seconds, BCD now asks iOS once per run for a 5 ms audio buffer, as `env.MADEIRA_AUDIO_IO_MS = 5` does; other games are not touched. Fixed for the logs it came from; not tested on a device yet. Quake II and Resonance carry that line in their recommended settings. Resonance's controller (DualSense in HID mode) also logs a one-minute line of what the game reads, and Quake II's file and registry trace names what the engine looks up before it chooses Direct3D 11 over Vulkan.
- **REANIMAL and Oar'some Adventures:** Metal aborted on a 64-bit texture atomic on A15, M1 and M2 chips, because the game was told the GPU had it. 64-bit texture atomics are now used only where the GPU has them (Apple9 and later). Fixed. REANIMAL's recommended settings also report capabilities by GPU family, so the game stops using the feature.
- **Red Dead Redemption 2:** Metal aborted on a 64-bit texture atomic on M1 chips (see REANIMAL above), which is fixed. Also new: a notice for a program started from the Windows desktop that has recommended settings (they apply only when it is added as a game with the + button), Auto-tune words for a start without the launcher ("choose the launcher's program"), and for the Launcher's Steam error 113 the replica line named under Grand Theft Auto V.
- **Resident Evil 5 and Portal:** a 32-bit program stored an uninitialised status block over translated code on phones with the small address map and ended with an illegal instruction. A status block that lies in a pool copy's code is now skipped. Fixed. For Resident Evil 5, a copy that carries its own `winmm.dll` now uses BCD's through the recommended settings, and the protection exit of the Steam copy (exit code `0x5...`) is named by Auto-tune and dumped with the 32-bit fault dump.
- **Rise of the Tomb Raider, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, The Witness, Transformers and Danganronpa:** a texture of an impossible size (an edge above 16384, or 32768 on the newest GPUs; a 3D texture or array above 2048) made Metal abort the game. Direct3D 12 and Direct3D 11 now refuse it with the error Windows gives, and a native check refuses it before Metal sees it. Fixed for the abort; the game may still fail later. A 64-bit Direct3D 11 game gets the Direct3D 11 part through the source-built Direct3D 11 (`env.MADEIRA_D3D11_SRC = 1`).
- **Roommate (demo) and The Edge Of: Definitive Edition:** a damaged relocation table of the program image sent BCD's loop outside the image: Roommate ended BCD with a bad store, The Edge Of hung for 57 to 76 seconds holding BCD's memory lock. The three walks now check every block and entry against the image. Fixed.
